name: psychrometric_mixer_condensation
title: Psychrometric mixer with condensation: room air mixed with outdoor air
summary: Room air (20 degC dry bulb, 19.2 degC wet bulb) mixed adiabatically with outdoor air (0 degC, 90 % relative humidity, 300 g/s of dry air) at 101 325 Pa; the mixture falls below saturation, so the balances of the dry air, of the water (with a condensate term) and of the energy give the temperature of the saturated mixture and the condensate flow rate.

authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002 - see README 'Source and attribution')
origin.course: ULiège Thermodynamique appliquée (MECA0002), exercise session R9 (2022-2023), exercise 3

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file R09_E03_2022.EES (EES 10.836), restricted to the variables it had actually solved, and an independent recomputation of the two balances with the psychrometric relations of the course (Python/CoolProp script, not shipped)
verification.notes: Hand-converted from kPa/kJ (only p = 101.325 kPa -> 101325 Pa; T=0[C] -> T=0 removes the CS-GAP-UNIT-NAMEDARG line, 100[%] -> 100 with the unit in the comment removes the CS-GAP-UNIT-SUBEXPR line). compare_solution.py --ees-units: 32 common variables, 20 above rtol 1e-3, but the stored solution of the file is a partly solved state: the 11 outlet-state variables (T_3, T[3], w_3, w[3], h_a_3, h_a_3bis, h_w, m_dot_v_3, m_dot_cond, r_cond, T_r3) store a user-typed guess that satisfies neither the equations nor the energy balance (42.8 kW against 21.1 kW), and are excluded. On the 21 remaining variables the largest deviation is 4.38e-03 (w_1, m_dot_v_1), the humid-air property difference between EES 10.836 and CoolProp documented for CSL-0055 (CoolProp humid air carries the water-enhancement factor); m_dot_a_1, p, T_1, T_2, T_h_1, phi_2, r_q agree to 5e-11 and phi_1 to 1.4e-05. The 22 variables only present in the EES record are the leftovers of an earlier exercise of the same file. Independent recomputation: T_3 = 11.5468 degC and m_dot_cond = 0.2226 g/s with the course relations, 11.5483 degC and 0.2260 g/s with the EES stored inlet properties (7.7e-04 / 2.3e-03 from CoolSolve); recomputing with the CoolProp humid-air code path reproduces the CoolSolve solution to all printed digits.
